title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 162 (Termination of gratuitous bailment by death)

content.overview: Section 162 provides that a gratuitous bailment is terminated by the death either of the bailor or of the bailee.
content.glance: A gratuitous bailment is terminated by the death of either the bailor or the bailee.
content.study: A gratuitous bailment is terminated by the death either of the bailor or of the bailee. Current-law framing: death of either party ends a gratuitous bailment automatically.

sections.heading: Core rule
sections.body: A gratuitous bailment is terminated by the death either of the bailor or of the bailee.

examples.title: Death terminates gratuitous bailment
examples.body: A gratuitous bailment ends upon the death of the bailor or the bailee under Section 162.

hypotheticals.question: Does the death of the bailee terminate a gratuitous bailment?
hypotheticals.analysis: Yes. Section 162 provides that a gratuitous bailment is terminated by the death of either party.

enhancement.detailedExplanation: Section 162 provides that a gratuitous bailment is terminated by the death either of the bailor or of the bailee. It applies specifically to gratuitous bailments.
